definitions: To improve one's situation by one's own efforts, without help from others.
examples: Despite a difficult childhood, she managed to pull herself up by her bootstraps and become a successful entrepreneur.
The community was encouraged to pull itself up by its bootstraps after the economic downturn.
lemma: pull oneself up by one's bootstraps
synonyms: stand on one's own two feet
source: pull oneself up by one's bootstraps
